what_it_proves: The small O(NK) PeerLite architecture can train, checkpoint, predict and record reproducibly across all seven frozen development folds.
Both registered peer counts preserve the unified (datetime, instrument) to score interface and remain below the 500,000-parameter ceiling.
The exact M3-qualified input, frozen M6 spec, code hashes, outputs and cumulative trial ledger form a traceable engineering base for isolated M7 increments.
what_it_does_not_prove: M6 deliberately performs no result-based K selection and does not establish that PeerLite beats LightGBM, MLP or any investable benchmark.
No cost-adjusted performance, capacity, portfolio robustness, final out-of-sample Alpha or production readiness is established.
M6 does not authorize combined CCC plus Gate testing, 2025+ access, text, LLM, high-frequency data or live trading.
